name: William Hubert Ferber — death (1903)
researcher_question: When and where did William Hubert Ferber (father of Charles Hubert Ferber, b. 1891, Cincinnati, Ohio) die?
notes: Single-focus death fixture, split off from the compound william-ferber-ancestry fixture. Full family context is retained, including parents Gerhard Ferber and Eva Engermann - only William's death (and burial) and their sources are stripped. Scoped to the death date/place only: William died 11 Mar 1903 Cincinnati, on the FamilySearch-indexed Ohio County Death Records original (ark 1:1:F66M-8JZ). Burial is deliberately NOT a finding - the burial-attesting records (Find a Grave, Spring Grove cemetery index) are not reliably reachable through the autonomous FamilySearch tools, so a burial finding would fail on tooling reach rather than agent capability. William's burial fact and those burial sources are still stripped because a 1903 burial reveals the 1903 death.
